import sys

MOD = 998244353

def scalar_pow(a, e):
    res = 1
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            res = res * a % MOD
        a = a * a % MOD
        e >>= 1
    return res

def symmetric_pow(p, q, e):
    rp = 1
    rq = 0
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            np = (rp * p + rq * q) % MOD
            nq = (rp * q + rq * p) % MOD
            rp, rq = np, nq
        np = (p * p + q * q) % MOD
        nq = (2 * p % MOD) * q % MOD
        p, q = np, nq
        e >>= 1
    return [rp, rq]

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])
    power = n * m

    if (n & 1) == 1 and (m & 1) == 1:
        total = r - l + 1
        result = scalar_pow(total, power)
    else:
        even = r // 2 - (l + 1) // 2 + 1
        odd = (r - l + 1) - even
        res = symmetric_pow(even, odd, power)
        result = res[0]
    sys.stdout.write(str(result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
